title: Your Vision. Lisa's Art.
intro: Compose a personal photo collection detail by detail. Your request is sent to Lisa in a private conversation, where you can discuss everything before any offer is made.
fromStudio: Taken from your Nail Studio selection
wishesPlaceholder: Describe the mood, a detail you love, or anything Lisa should know…
wishesHint: Please keep requests artistic and respectful. Lisa decides which requests she accepts.
giftHint: Click the box to open it
greeting: Hello Lisa, I would love to request a personalized photo collection.
loginRequired: To send your request, please sign in and complete the one-time age verification. Your selection is saved and waiting for you.
nothingSelected: Choose at least one detail or describe your wishes.

h1.title: Compose
h1.body: Choose colours, styling and mood — or simply describe your idea.

h2.title: Discuss
h2.body: Your request arrives in a private conversation with Lisa.

h3.title: Receive an offer
h3.body: If Lisa accepts, she sends you a personal offer with price and delivery.

h4.title: Enjoy
h4.body: After checkout, your collection is delivered to your private account.
